GallKeepMoving.name: Keep Moving!
GallKeepMoving.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Shove by 10% and its duration by 2 seconds.

GallTaskmaster.name: Taskmaster
GallTaskmaster.description: Every time Cho is hit by a Hero Basic Attack, reduce the cooldown of Shove by 1 second.

GallWeSeeYou.name: We See You!
GallWeSeeYou.description: Eye of Kilrogg's cooldown is decreased by 25 seconds, its range is increased by 33%, and the number of Basic Attacks required to kill it is increased by 1.

GallRisingDread.name: Rising Dread
GallRisingDread.description: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 25% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

GallRunicPersistence.name: Runic Persistence
GallRunicPersistence.description: Runic Blast deals an additional 180 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds in an area around the detonation point.

GallBombsAway.name: Bomb's Away
GallBombsAway.description: Quest: Damaging a Hero with Runic Blast increases its damage by 5, up to 200. Reward: After damaging 20 Heroes, the range and speed of Cho's Rune Bomb is increased by 20%.

GallEdgeOfMadness.name: Edge of Madness
GallEdgeOfMadness.description: Every subsequent hit of Shadowflame against the same enemy Hero deals an additional 12% damage, to a maximum of 60%. These bonuses are lost if the Hero has not been hit for 7 seconds.

GallDoubleTrouble.name: Double Trouble
GallDoubleTrouble.description: Quest: If Shadowflame hits an enemy Hero that is afflicted by Cho's Consuming Blaze, its cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds. Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Shadowflame's cooldown is instead permanently reduced by 0.5 seconds.

GallOgreRampage.name: Ogre Rampage
GallOgreRampage.description: Increase the damage bonus of Ogre Rage by 5%. Each time Gall damages an enemy Hero this bonus increases by 1% for 4 seconds, up to an additional 10% bonus damage.

GallHeroicAbilityShadowboltVolley.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
GallHeroicAbilityShadowboltVolley.description: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87 (+4% per level) damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

GallHeroicAbilityTwistingNether.name: Twisting Nether
GallHeroicAbilityTwistingNether.description: After 1 second, nearby enemies are slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 (+5% per level) damage.

GallSearingShadows.name: Searing Shadows
GallSearingShadows.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Shadowflame take an additional 2% of their maximum Health as damage.

GallPsychoticBreak.name: Psychotic Break
GallPsychoticBreak.description: Increase Gall's damage to enemy Heroes by 10%. Upon dying, Gall gains Ogre Rage and can use Abilities for 10 seconds.

GallTwilightNova.name: Twilight Nova
GallTwilightNova.description: After the first bounce of Dread Orb, 2 extra bombs bounce to the sides once.

GallLeadenOrb.name: Leaden Orb
GallLeadenOrb.description: Dread Orb Stuns enemy Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

GallDeafeningBlast.name: Deafening Blast
GallDeafeningBlast.description: Runic Blast Silences enemy Heroes for 1.25 seconds.

GallShadowsnare.name: Shadowsnare
GallShadowsnare.description: Enemy Heroes hit by your Basic Abilities are Slowed by 15% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times.

GallShadowboltVolleyShadowfury.name: Shadowfury
GallShadowboltVolleyShadowfury.description: Shadow Bolt Volley hits all enemies in its path.

GallShiftingNether.name: Shifting Nether
GallShiftingNether.description: Twisting Nether now teleports Cho to a targeted location before it begins Channeling.

GallTheWillofGall.name: The Will of Gall
GallTheWillofGall.description: Takedowns permanently increase the bonus of Ogre Rage by 2%.

GallTwilightFrenzy.name: Twilight Frenzy
GallTwilightFrenzy.description: Activate to reduce the cooldowns of Shadowflame and Dread Orb to 2 seconds for the next 6 seconds.
